question.worked_solution:
To find $\text{dim}(\text{Null}(D))$, we reduce $D$ to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & -2 & 1 & -2 \\ 8 & 0 & 10 & 9 & 7 \\ 0 & 8 & -4 & 2 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & -2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & -4 & 2 & -3 & 3 \\ 0 & 8 & -4 & 2 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & -2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 8 & -4 & 2 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & -2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The reduced matrix has $3$ pivot columns and $2$ non-pivot columns (namely, the $3$rd and $5$th columns). 

Therefore,

$$
\text{dim}(\text{Null}(D))=2.
$$
